card.name: Digit zero inside years and numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 in the middle of a multi-digit number, mostly the second digit of a year such as 1806 or 1902. Also seen in citation volumes, statute numbers and dates.

modes.label: Zero inside a year
modes.description: The 0 sits in the hundreds place of a year, often in a birth-death range.

modes.label: Zero in citations and codes
modes.description: The 0 sits inside a case reporter, statute or reference number.

card.writes: It seems to steer away from number-continuation tokens and toward Chinese words such as 年代, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on a zero in the middle of a number, usually inside a year like 1806 or 1902.
